info.name: Assignment 2 - Posts & Comments CRUD
info.description: Select the Assignment 2 environment and run folders 01?05 in order. See docs/ASSIGNMENT2_TESTING.md.

item.name: 01 - Authentication Setup
item.description: Use three existing verified disposable accounts. Keep A public to begin and do not use real account credentials. Successful requests capture each user ID and Bearer token.

04 - Ownership and Security
item.description: Owner and non-owner update/delete checks are in folders 02 and 03. These requests test protected fields and privacy. Run Restore A?s public visibility if you stop after making A private.

item.name: C cannot read A?s private post
